title: Good for veggies, but not onions.
text: Good for veggies, but not onions.. Bought this for my mother-in-law after she had wrist surgery. Was hoping this could help her still cook at home, but it wasn't really strong enough to cut the things that she wanted, like onions.

product_metadata.title: Prepworks by Progressive Fruit and Vegetable Chopper
features: One handed food chopper, ideal for chopping nuts, fruits, vegetables, chocolate and more
Dice, slice and chop fruits and veggies without the mess of a cutting board
Press down on pusher lid and food is cut into included measuring container
Built-in side blade which minimizes the need for precutting
Includes cleaning tool and storage box; dishwasher safe
description: The Prepworks by Progressive Fruit and Vegetable Chopper chops, dices and slices a variety of fruits and vegetables in one swift motion. Built-in side blade minimizes need for pre-cutting. Measurements printed on non-skid base container. Includes cleaning tool and storage box. Dishwasher safe.
